QUOTE: By default it expands `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` to `ctx->private_state`, so the member is renamed.; `library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally. Library translation units that include `common.h` get `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expanding to plain `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to `private_<member>` and that defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` makes the macro expand to the plain member name.
